items.title: GlassWorm malware returns on OpenVSX with 3 new VSCode extensions
items.description: The GlassWorm malware campaign, which impacted the OpenVSX and Visual Studio Code marketplaces last month, has returned with three new VSCode extensions that have already been downloaded over 10,000 times. [...]

items.title: Still on Windows 10? Enroll in free ESU before next week’s Patch Tuesday
items.description: With the first Patch Tuesday following Windows 10's end of support approaching next week, users who continue to run the operating system should enroll in the Extended Security Updates (ESU) program to remain protected against newly discovered security vulnerabilities. [...]
